title.zh: 泰达币2025年报表获毕马威无保留审计意见
title.en: Tether gets clean KPMG audit opinion for 2025 statements

summary.zh: 最大的稳定币发行方泰达币首次完成了对其2025年财务报表的全面独立审计，毕马威出具了无保留（干净）审计意见。审计显示其储备金超过负债68.14亿美元。 这是最大的稳定币发行方在透明度方面的一个重要里程碑，可能增强市场对USDT及整个稳定币市场的信心，而稳定币市场支撑着加密货币交易的大部分流动性。此举使泰达币超越了季度鉴证，达到了传统金融机构所期望的全面审计标准。 毕马威实际检查并逐一清点了泰达币持有的黄金，而非仅依赖托管机构的记录。审计涵盖了截至2025年12月31日年度的资产负债表、损益表和现金流量表，发现储备金超过负债68.14亿美元。
summary.en: Tether, the largest stablecoin issuer, completed its first full independent audit of its 2025 financial statements, with KPMG issuing a clean (unqualified) opinion. The audit showed reserves exceeded liabilities by $6.814 billion. This is a significant transparency milestone for the largest stablecoin issuer, potentially boosting confidence in USDT and the broader stablecoin market, which underpins much of crypto trading liquidity. It moves Tether beyond quarterly attestations to the full audit standard expected of traditional financial institutions. KPMG physically inspected and counted Tether's gold holdings bar-by-bar, rather than relying only on custodian records. The audit covered the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flows for the year ended Dec. 31, 2025, and found reserves exceeded liabilities by $6.814 billion.

title.zh: 安全综述：Harmony 桥攻击与 BTCPay 服务器漏洞
title.en: Security Roundup Covers Harmony Bridge Hack and BTCPay Server Flaws

summary.zh: 这份安全综述涵盖了两起重大事件：2022 年 6 月 Harmony Horizon 桥遭攻击导致约 1 亿美元损失，以及 BTCPay Server 的一个严重漏洞使攻击者能够从运行 LND 的 Lightning 节点中盗取资金。 这份综述凸显了跨链桥和比特币支付基础设施中持续存在的风险，一次攻击就可能直接危及用户资金。DeFi 用户、桥运营方以及依赖 Lightning 支付的商家都会受到影响，并可能促使整个加密基础设施加强安全审查。 在 Harmony 事件中，攻击者似乎控制了该桥背后的多重签名合约，约有 64,000 个钱包受到影响。在 BTCPay Server 事件中，该漏洞暴露了 LND Lightning 节点的凭据，官方敦促运营方升级到 2.4.2 版本或将服务器下线。
summary.en: A security roundup covers two major incidents: the Harmony Horizon bridge exploit that lost roughly $100 million in June 2022, and a critical BTCPay Server vulnerability that let attackers drain funds from Lightning nodes running LND. The roundup underscores persistent risks in cross-chain bridges and Bitcoin payment infrastructure, where a single exploit can directly compromise user funds. It affects DeFi users, bridge operators, and merchants relying on Lightning payments, and may heighten security scrutiny across crypto infrastructure. For Harmony, the attacker appears to have taken control of the multisig contract behind the bridge, affecting roughly 64,000 wallets. For BTCPay Server, the vulnerability exposed LND Lightning node credentials, and operators were urged to update to version 2.4.2 or take servers offline.

title.zh: Tether 首次获得 KPMG 对 2025 年财务报告的清洁审计意见
title.en: Tether receives KPMG clean audit opinion for 2025 financials

summary.zh: KPMG 美国已对 Tether International 的 2025 年完整财务报表出具了无保留（清洁）审计意见，Tether 于周四宣布了这一消息。这是 USDT 发行方首次完成全面审计。 Tether 是最大的稳定币发行方，获得四大会计师事务所的无保留审计意见显著提升了其财务透明度和可信度。这可能推动机构采用，并吸引监管机构对稳定币储备的更严格审视。 “无保留意见”意味着审计师认为财务报表公允列报且符合 GAAP，不存在重大错报。此次审计具体覆盖 Tether International 的 2025 年完整财务数据。
summary.en: KPMG U.S. issued an unqualified (clean) audit opinion on Tether International's full 2025 financial statements, announced by Tether on Thursday. This marks the first time the USDT issuer has completed a full audit. Tether is the largest stablecoin issuer, and a clean audit from a Big Four firm materially improves financial transparency and credibility. This could ease institutional adoption and invite closer regulatory scrutiny of stablecoin reserves. An unqualified opinion means the auditor found the financial statements fairly presented and compliant with GAAP, with no material misstatements. The audit specifically covers Tether International's full 2025 financials.

title.zh: 安全回顾：Harmony 桥遭攻击，BTCPay Server 存在漏洞
title.en: Harmony Bridge Hack and BTCPay Vulnerability Exposed in Security Roundup

summary.zh: 新的安全回顾重点披露了两起事件：2022 年 6 月 Harmony Horizon 跨链桥遭攻击，损失约 1 亿美元；以及 BTCPay Server 中存在一个正被积极利用的严重漏洞，可能导致闪电网络节点资金被窃取。 这些事件凸显了跨链桥设计和支付服务器安全方面的持续弱点，使用户资金面临风险，也加大了监管部门和社区对加密基础设施的审视。 Harmony 桥采用 2/5 多签方案，攻击者窃取两把私钥即可批准恶意交易；FBI 将该攻击归因于朝鲜的 Lazarus 集团。开源比特币支付处理器 BTCPay Server 已针对被积极利用的漏洞发布紧急补丁。
summary.en: A new security roundup highlights two incidents: the June 2022 Harmony Horizon Bridge hack that lost about $100 million, and an actively exploited critical vulnerability in BTCPay Server that can drain Lightning Network node funds. These incidents underscore persistent weaknesses in cross-chain bridge design and payment server security, putting user funds at risk and increasing regulatory and community scrutiny on crypto infrastructure. The Harmony bridge was protected by a 2-of-5 multisig scheme, and attackers stole two private keys to approve malicious transactions; the FBI attributed the attack to North Korea's Lazarus Group. BTCPay Server, an open-source Bitcoin payment processor, issued an emergency patch for the actively exploited vulnerability.

title.en: Coinbase's Base Abandons Optimistic Rollups, Bets $12B on ZK Proofs

summary.zh: 据Yellow.com报道，Coinbase旗下Layer-2网络Base计划放弃乐观Rollup，转而采用零知识（ZK）证明，这一战略转变涉及约120亿美元的网络价值。目前Coinbase或Base尚未正式确认这一转型。 Base是最大的以太坊Layer-2网络之一，其核心架构的切换将对L2生态、在Base上构建的开发者以及OP Stack的竞争定位产生广泛影响。如果属实，这还可能加速整个行业向基于ZK的扩展方案转变。 报道中提到的120亿美元反映了Base生态系统的资产或价值规模。由于这条消息来自二级媒体报道而非官方公告，具体的路线图、时间表和技术实现方式仍不明确。
summary.en: According to a report from Yellow.com, Coinbase's Layer-2 network Base is planning to move away from optimistic rollups and adopt zero-knowledge (ZK) proofs, a strategic shift tied to roughly $12 billion in network value. The transition has not yet been officially confirmed by Coinbase or Base. Base is one of the largest Ethereum Layer-2 networks, so switching its core architecture would have broad implications for the L2 ecosystem, developers building on Base, and the competitive positioning of the OP Stack. If confirmed, it could also accelerate the broader industry shift toward ZK-based scaling. The reported $12 billion figure reflects the scale of assets or value associated with the Base ecosystem. Because the news comes from a secondary outlet rather than an official announcement, the specific roadmap, timeline, and technical implementation details remain unclear.

title.zh: Anthropic 分析新兴多智能体系统的模式与问题
title.en: Anthropic Analyzes Patterns and Problems in Emerging Multiagent Systems

summary.zh: Anthropic 发布了一篇题为《新兴多智能体系统中的模式与问题》的分析文章，分享了其对多智能体 AI 系统结构及其常见失败点的观察。这篇文章体现了 Anthropic 在代理式 AI 前沿领域的视角，正值该领域从单代理部署向多代理部署演进。 作为领先的 AI 实验室之一，Anthropic 的分析有助于开发者和企业理解编排多个 AI 代理时的实际权衡。多智能体系统正迅速从研究走向生产，因此权威机构对常见陷阱的指导可能会影响整个行业的工程实践。 根据标题，该分析强调多智能体 AI 系统中反复出现的架构模式和常见协调问题，而非推广特定工具或产品。这表明报告以分类学为导向，旨在帮助团队思考何时以及如何组合多个代理。
summary.en: Anthropic published an analysis titled 'Patterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems,' sharing its observations on how multiagent AI systems are structured and where they tend to fail. The piece reflects Anthropic's perspective on the current frontier of agentic AI as the field moves from single-agent to multi-agent deployments. As one of the leading AI labs, Anthropic's analysis helps developers and enterprises understand the practical trade-offs of orchestrating multiple AI agents. This is significant because multiagent systems are rapidly moving from research to production, and authoritative guidance on pitfalls can shape engineering practices across the industry. Given the title, the analysis emphasizes recurring architectural patterns and common coordination problems in multiagent AI systems, rather than promoting a specific tool or product. This suggests a taxonomy-oriented report aimed at helping teams reason about when and how to combine multiple agents.

title.zh: Tether完成首次四大审计，KPMG对USDT储备出具无保留意见
title.en: Tether Completes First Big Four Audit; KPMG Issues Unqualified Opinion on USDT Reserves

summary.zh: Tether宣布，KPMG U.S.已对其2025年财务报表出具无保留意见，这是该稳定币发行方首次完成四大会计师事务所的全面审计。财务报表显示，其储备超过负债68.14亿美元。 此次审计回应了长期以来对USDT储备透明度的批评；USDT是规模达1800亿美元、对加密货币交易流动性至关重要的稳定币。四大会计师事务所出具无保留意见，可能增强市场对Tether的信任，并缓解数字资产领域的系统性风险担忧。 KPMG的审计超出了Tether此前季度鉴证的范围，测试了交易、系统、估值、交易对手方和所有权记录，并实地清点了公司的金条。Tether尚未确认是否会公开发布KPMG的完整报告。
summary.en: Tether announced that KPMG U.S. issued an unqualified opinion on its 2025 financial statements, marking the stablecoin issuer's first full audit by a Big Four accounting firm. The statements showed reserves exceeding liabilities by $6.814 billion. The audit addresses a long-standing transparency criticism over the reserves backing USDT, a $180 billion stablecoin that is critical to crypto trading liquidity. An unqualified opinion from a Big Four firm could strengthen market trust in Tether and ease systemic risk concerns across digital-asset markets. KPMG went beyond Tether's prior quarterly attestations by testing transactions, systems, valuations, counterparties and ownership records, and physically counting the company's gold bars. Tether has not yet confirmed whether it will publicly release the full KPMG report.

title.zh: Protos追踪HTX储备转移至Poloniex，引发偿付能力担忧
title.en: Protos tracks HTX reserves moving to Poloniex amid sanctions

summary.zh: Protos报道称，HTX六月份的储备证明首次承认将大部分用户资金转移至未披露的‘第三方’托管人，链上追踪显示包括WBTC和sUSDS在内的数亿美元资产从HTX钱包转移至Poloniex地址。 这很重要，因为HTX正受到欧盟和英国的制裁，其不透明的储备管理以及快速的钱包频繁更换引发了对偿付能力和用户资金安全的严重质疑。调查结果还牵涉到同为孙宇晨旗下交易所的Poloniex，涉及处理来自受制裁实体的资产。 Protos追踪了具体转账：WBTC从HTX地址0x18709e...转移至Poloniex 7，再到Poloniex 10，最后到Poloniex 9；约2亿美元的sUSDS也走了类似路径。HTX五月份的储备证明还错误标注了STEAK-USDC，该地址实际持有的是sUSDS。
summary.en: Protos reports that HTX's June proof-of-reserves acknowledged moving large portions of user funds to an undisclosed 'ThirdParty' custodian, and on-chain tracking shows hundreds of millions of dollars in assets, including WBTC and sUSDS, moved from HTX wallets to Poloniex addresses. This matters because HTX is under EU and UK sanctions, and its opaque reserve management plus rapid wallet churning raise serious solvency and user-fund safety questions. The findings also implicate Poloniex, another Justin Sun-owned exchange, in handling assets from a sanctioned entity. Protos tracked specific transfers: WBTC moved from HTX address 0x18709e... to Poloniex 7, then Poloniex 10, then Poloniex 9; about $200 million in sUSDS followed a similar path. HTX's May proof-of-reserves also mislabeled STEAK-USDC when the address actually held sUSDS.

title.zh: 泰达获KPMG对2025年财报的里程碑式审计
title.en: Tether Secures Landmark KPMG Audit of 2025 Financials

summary.zh: 泰达宣布，KPMG美国对其2025年财务报表出具了无保留意见审计报告，这是该公司首次完成全面独立审计。该公告发布于2026年8月13日。 四大会计师事务所出具的无保留意见是独立审计师给予的最高程度保证，可能显著增强市场对泰达储备与透明度的信心。这一里程碑也会引起更严格的监管关注，并可能加速机构与传统金融领域对稳定币的采用。 本次审计针对Tether International, S.A. de C.V.的财务报表，意见覆盖2025财年。泰达称此次审计为历史上规模最大的首次财务审计，突显其作为数字资产行业最大公司的运营规模。
summary.en: Tether announced that KPMG U.S. issued an unqualified audit opinion on its 2025 financial statements, marking the first full independent audit of the company. The announcement was made on 13 August 2026. An unqualified opinion from a Big Four firm is the strongest form of independent auditor assurance and could materially strengthen market confidence in Tether's reserves and transparency. This milestone also invites closer regulatory scrutiny and may accelerate stablecoin adoption by institutional and traditional finance players. The audit was of Tether International, S.A. de C.V.'s financial statements, and the opinion covers the 2025 fiscal year. Tether described the audit as the largest inaugural financial audit in history, underscoring the scale of its operations as the largest company in the digital asset industry.

title.zh: Anthropic悄悄为新版Claude输出嵌入水印，开发者竞相破解
title.en: Anthropic Quietly Watermarks New Claude Outputs; Builders Race to Strip It

summary.zh: Anthropic已开始在其最新Claude模型生成的文本中嵌入肉眼不可见、并通过对模型训练实现的模型级水印；该措施适用于2026年8月2日及之后在欧盟发布的新模型，并将覆盖全球范围内的Claude聊天界面、API、Claude Code，以及AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Foundry等云合作伙伴。这一部署是Anthropic签署欧盟《人工智能法案》透明度《实践准则》之后的合规举措。 这是主流AI实验室首次大规模部署模型级水印，将波及全球所有Claude用户、开发者及企业客户。此举可能为整个行业在欧盟《人工智能法案》框架下如何落实内容来源标识与透明度义务树立先例，也考验开发者对隐藏且暂不可验证的标记技术的反应。 Anthropic尚未公布检测方法、判定阈值或具体技术细节；研究人员推测其原理与Google SynthID Text类似，即依赖统计性的词元选择偏差嵌入信号。水印在复制粘贴后仍然保留，部分编辑也不会使其消失，文件还会附带C2PA签名元数据；但大幅编辑可去除水印，且没有水印并不能证明内容出自人类之手。
summary.en: Anthropic has begun embedding an imperceptible, model-level watermark into text generated by its newest Claude models, effective for models launched in the EU on or after August 2, 2026, and applied worldwide across the Claude chatbot, API, Claude Code, and cloud partners including AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry. The rollout follows Anthropic's signing of the EU AI Act's Code of Practice on transparency obligations. This is one of the first large-scale, model-level watermark rollouts by a major AI lab, touching every Claude user, developer, and enterprise customer worldwide. It could set an industry precedent for how provenance and transparency rules under the EU AI Act are implemented, and how the market reacts to hidden, unverifiable labeling techniques. Anthropic has not yet published the detection method, thresholds, or the exact technique; researchers infer it is a statistical token-selection bias similar to Google's SynthID Text. The watermark survives copy-paste and some editing, and files also carry C2PA signed metadata, but heavy editing can strip it, and a missing watermark does not prove human authorship.

title.zh: 理解成为AI辅助编程的新瓶颈
title.en: Understanding Becomes the New Bottleneck in AI-Assisted Coding

summary.zh: Geoffrey Litt 的文章指出，随着AI越来越多地生成代码，软件开发的关键约束正从编写代码转向人类对现有代码库的深度理解。这篇文章在Hacker News上引发了强烈关注，获得了176个点赞和92条评论。 这种重新定义很重要，因为它挑战了“AI编程工具主要节省开发者时间”的假设；相反，它凸显出理解和审查AI生成的代码成为核心瓶颈。它影响工程团队如何组织工作流程、投资文档，以及如何评估AI时代的开发者生产力。 文章指出，AI生成代码的速度快于人类理解代码的速度，因此理解成为限制因素。虽然未提供全文，但作者可能提出了改进代码理解的策略；讨论中涉及了规范驱动开发（Spec Driven Development）以及AI生成误解的风险等主题。
summary.en: Geoffrey Litt's essay argues that as AI increasingly generates code, the critical constraint in software development shifts from writing code to maintaining a deep human understanding of the existing codebase. The piece has sparked strong engagement on Hacker News, with 176 points and 92 comments. This reframing matters because it challenges the assumption that AI coding tools primarily save developer time; instead, it highlights that understanding and reviewing AI-generated code becomes the central bottleneck. It affects how engineering teams structure workflows, invest in documentation, and evaluate developer productivity in the age of AI. The essay draws on the observation that AI can produce code faster than humans can comprehend it, making comprehension the limiting factor. The author likely proposes strategies to improve code understanding, although the full content is not provided; the discussion suggests themes like specification-driven development and the risk of AI-generated misunderstandings.

title.zh: 美国SEC拟为代币化股票制定监管框架
title.en: SEC Targets Regulatory Framework for Tokenized Stocks

summary.zh: 美国SEC计划提出“Regulation Crypto”监管框架，并为代币化股票设立创新豁免，可能允许追踪苹果、特斯拉等股票的代币在区块链上全天候交易。相关细节可能于周五的公开会议上公布。 这将为代币化证券市场提供法律确定性，该市场在Robinhood Chain、Solana和Base等平台上快速增长，却一直处于监管灰色地带。正式的豁免可能打开美国散户参与渠道，并进一步使真实世界资产（RWA）趋势合法化。 拟议的豁免适用于追踪股票经济敞口但不带投票权或股息权的代币，因此监管负担较轻。由于《数字资产市场清晰法案》（CLARITY Act）在国会至少推迟至9月，SEC主席保罗·阿特金斯（Paul Atkins）在“Project Crypto”议程下自行推进。
summary.en: The SEC plans to propose 'Regulation Crypto' and an innovation exemption for tokenized stocks, potentially allowing tokens tracking stocks like Apple and Tesla to trade on blockchains around the clock. Details could be unveiled at a Friday open meeting. This would provide legal clarity for the tokenized securities market, which has grown rapidly on platforms like Robinhood Chain, Solana, and Base while operating in a regulatory gray zone. A formal exemption could open U.S. retail access and further legitimize the real-world asset (RWA) trend. The intended exemption applies to tokens that track a stock's economic exposure but carry no voting or dividend rights, justifying lighter regulatory treatment. The CLARITY Act remains stalled in Congress until at least September, prompting the SEC to act unilaterally under Chair Paul Atkins' 'Project Crypto' agenda.

title.zh: SEC批准富兰克林坦伯顿基金投资其链上货币基金
title.en: SEC lets Franklin Templeton funds invest in its onchain money fund

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）发布无异议函，表示若富兰克林坦伯顿旗下基金将现金投入其链上美国政府货币基金（BENJI），将不会采取执法行动。该豁免还允许关联过户代理FTIS作为托管人持有私钥，而无需遵守现行实物托管规则。 这是一个重大监管里程碑：SEC明确允许大型资产管理公司投资自家代币化货币市场基金，并为其数字资产托管提供豁免。此举推动链上基金的机构化采用，也为现有基金规则如何适应基于区块链的记账方式树立了先例。 SEC的信函列出了12项条件，包括要求富兰克林坦伯顿维护防止未经授权指令的系统，以及要求FTIS具备纠正、冻结、迁移或恢复记录的行政控制能力。据RWA.xyz数据，富兰克林坦伯顿管理着25亿美元链上资产，是第五大代币化资产管理公司。
summary.en: The SEC issued a no-action letter stating it will not pursue enforcement action if Franklin Templeton funds invest cash in the Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (BENJI). The relief also allows affiliated transfer agent FTIS to act as custodian and hold private keys without adhering to existing physical-custody rules. This is a major regulatory milestone: the SEC explicitly permits a large asset manager to invest in its own tokenized money market fund and grants custody relief for digital assets. It advances institutional adoption of onchain funds and sets a precedent for adapting traditional fund rules to blockchain-based recordkeeping. The SEC's letter outlines 12 conditions, including systems to prevent unauthorized instructions and administrative controls for FTIS to correct, freeze, migrate, or restore records. Franklin Templeton manages $2.5 billion in onchain assets and is the fifth-largest tokenized asset manager, according to RWA.xyz.

title.zh: Coinbase等15家x402支付服务商未通过面向AI代理经济的安全测试
title.en: Coinbase and 14 other x402 facilitators failed security tests built for the coming AI-agent economy

summary.zh: 研究人员在美国USENIX安全研讨会上测试了15家主要的x402支付服务商，包括Coinbase、Thirdweb、PayAI和Mogami，发现每个平台都至少违反了一条安全规则。他们将被研究的系统中99%的已观测x402交易和98%支付量对应的49条规则违规行为，映射为31个不同的安全漏洞。 x402正被推广为机器驱动商业的基础设施，允许AI代理自主完成服务付费，但这些漏洞可能导致商家在交付商品后收不到付款，并暴露服务商持有的资产和网络费用。这些发现凸显了新兴AI代理支付经济中的系统性风险，可能影响人们对基于稳定币的自动化支付的信任。 研究人员识别出四大类攻击（免费购物、资产窃取、服务中断和Gas滥用），并直接验证了六条攻击路径，包括两条免费购物攻击、三条Gas滥用攻击，以及一条通过恶意ERC-6492元数据暴露服务商持有资产的路径。他们还分析了Base和Solana上1.19亿笔x402交易，发现服务商共花费约20.2万美元的网络费用，其中约5800美元用于最终回滚或失败的Base交易。
summary.en: Researchers testing 15 major x402 payment facilitators at the USENIX Security Symposium found that every platform, including Coinbase, Thirdweb, PayAI and Mogami, violated at least one security rule. They mapped 49 rule violations to 31 distinct vulnerabilities across systems handling 99% of observed x402 transactions and 98% of payment volume during the study. x402 is being promoted as infrastructure for machine-driven commerce, allowing AI agents to autonomously pay for services, yet these flaws could leave merchants unpaid for goods they have already delivered and expose facilitator-held assets and network fees. The findings highlight systemic risks in the emerging AI-agent payment economy and could affect trust in stablecoin-based automated payments. Researchers identified four broad attack classes (free shopping, asset theft, service disruption, and gas abuse) and directly validated six attack paths, including two free-shopping attacks, three gas-abuse attacks, and one path that could expose facilitator-held assets via malicious ERC-6492 metadata. They also analyzed 119 million x402 transactions on Base and Solana, finding facilitators spent about $202,000 on network fees, including roughly $5,800 on reverted or failed Base transactions.
